partnershipPlan: Three members of the network's patient participation group, one without a regular dentist, review the analgesia sheet and the practice notices.
socialListening: No social media listening; the community dental service's complaint themes are shared in anonymised form.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I rang every dentist in town; the GP was the only person who would see me.
items.implication: The triage line must offer a real appointment, not only advice.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I cannot see into the jaw; if I send them away and it spreads, that is on me.
items.implication: Make red flags and the same-day route explicit in the decision aid.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We can take the calls, but we need to know how many to expect each week.
items.implication: Report triage use monthly and review capacity.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Nobody told me the painkillers work better than the antibiotics for this.
items.implication: Give clear analgesia advice with every consultation.

summary: Four composite voices on access, fear of infection, triage capacity and pain relief.
